name: AgentMesh
capabilities: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer: Screenshots piling up? Tuck's AI reads every screenshot and file you save: bookings, receipts and warranties, and the restaurants, recipes and things to buy you screenshot. It files each one and finds it again from a few words. Reading happens on your device, with Apple Intelligence where available; Advanced reading by Claude is optional.
Inside: Phone Check: A warm, clear look at your whole phone: checks, hardware, battery, performance, charging.

Roomory: Floor Plans: From moving a sofa to planning a renovation, Roomory helps you turn the space you have into the layout you want. Scan a room or start by hand, then edit your floor plans and preview your ideas in 3D.
Daikon: Period Tracker: A little care, every day.
ZaiRi: Plant Watering Reminder: Give every plant day a place to grow.
Nightvane: Star Guide: Hold your iPhone or iPad up to the night and Nightvane shows what you are looking at: stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way, right where they are.
Lockwater: Canal Puzzle: Lockwater is a canal puzzle made of soft clay: a row of stone chambers, a few wooden gates, and boats that must reach the flag of their color.

Prawnlight: Prawn Hall Tycoon: Prawnlight is a management game set in a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall that stays open late into the night. You are the boss, not the angler: order stock, release prawns, lay out the floor, hire staff and keep the guests fishing until closing time.
Precision Parking 3D: Slow down. Find your angle. Make every space count.
Hearscape: Sound Locator: Hearscape turns your phone into a sound radar and noise log.
Folkline: Forum Reader: Folkline is a forum reader with PTT support: AI reads the mood of a thread for you, and posts, pushes and the editor never show ads.

AutoCombo: AutoCombo plans your orb-matching moves. Take a screenshot in your game, come back and tap once: AutoCombo finds the board, reads every orb and draws a route you can follow with your finger.
Pow3: Dig down, one level at a time. Matches beside the rock break it.
Splash Car: Rocket Garage: Your water-rocket car always launches at full power. Whether it finishes the track is down to your build.
